tests.setup: Clean installation with valid base content
tests.expected: Content validates and Main Menu appears without an error.

tests.setup: One required content reference is intentionally invalid
tests.expected: Play is blocked by Content Error with file, content ID, and field; the game does not crash.
New Game is enabled and Continue is disabled.

tests.action: Attempt to continue with missing required choices
tests.expected: Creation remains open and identifies every missing choice.
The fourth selection is rejected until another positive trait is deselected.

tests.action: Choose a birthday that would not make the protagonist 18
tests.expected: The date is rejected with an age requirement message.

tests.setup: Complete every required field with Standard background
tests.expected: A version-1 runtime state is created with the Standard budget, loadout, traits, and opening date.
The player begins in the bedroom Tuesday Morning and Elena's opening conversation starts.
Elena Comfort increases once and the correct next node appears.
Enroll at Westshore starts, rent is waived while enrolled, and allowance is active.
Find Employment starts, allowance is inactive, and $250 rent is due September 1.
Enrollment and part-time employment quests start without conflicting initial rules.
Sandbox movement and phone quest tracker unlock exactly once.

The background artwork is the unframed VN stage, only arrows with real destinations float over it, and present NPCs appear as portrait sprites without a location or occupancy card; the player can leave and return through the connected home path.

tests.setup: Lily's door is closed and permission is absent
tests.expected: The player knocks or receives a privacy response and cannot walk through.
Time and Hygiene change once and the bathroom becomes available afterward.

tests.action: Cook and eat a basic meal
tests.expected: Ingredients are consumed and Hunger, time, Energy, and Cooking experience update.
A weather warning identifies missing protection but still permits the deliberate choice.
Detergent uses and time are consumed and clothing cleanliness increases.

tests.setup: Visit Lily's or the parents' doorway across different dates and activity blocks
tests.action: Inspect and knock on the door
tests.expected: The deterministic door state can be locked or unlocked-but-private, sleeping blocks lock the authored doors, and story overrides remain possible.

tests.setup: A household member is using the family bathroom or a story override locks it
tests.expected: The door reports occupied or locked, hygiene actions are unavailable, and the player may knock or spend twenty minutes waiting before checking again.

tests.action: Open and close the phone using keyboard and controller
tests.expected: Phone focus works and world input does not move the player while it is open.

tests.action: Inspect needs, attributes, skills, traits, and outfit
tests.expected: Values match runtime state and use text or icons as well as color.
Family, Emma, and Marcus appear; undiscovered NPCs do not expose private information.
The calendar scheduler opens with Emma's valid availability.

tests.setup: Two events use the same block
tests.expected: A double-booking warning appears and the player may confirm or cancel.

tests.action: Attempt to schedule that NPC during work
tests.expected: The time cannot be confirmed and alternative free windows are shown.

tests.action: Track a quest and select its location
tests.expected: Tracker and City Map identify the correct objective and destination.
Temperature, rain, wind, and clothing guidance match opening-week data.

tests.setup: Player at Hale home with route unlocked
tests.expected: Time, needs, location, and weather exposure update using the selected route.

tests.setup: Player has at least $3 and bus is operating
tests.expected: $3 is charged, travel time advances, and player arrives at Westshore.

tests.setup: Night block when bus is closed
tests.expected: Bus is unavailable and next operating block is shown.
Arrival warning appears before money or time is consumed.

tests.setup: Insufficient cash and checking funds with credit disabled
tests.action: Attempt a paid trip or purchase
tests.expected: Transaction is declined atomically without consuming the item or advancing travel.

tests.setup: Player is at the Hale front yard
tests.action: Follow scene arrows toward city transit
tests.expected: The player walks through the Hale block and neighborhood corner to the bus shelter, where destination selection becomes available; neither a side panel nor the phone map can bypass rooms, doors, or the neighborhood path.

The courtyard connects Administration, Library, Cafeteria, academic wings, Career Board, Student Lounge, Bookshop, Transit Loop, Cypress Hall, and Maple Hall; invitation-only dorm bedrooms are not offered publicly.

tests.setup: An NPC residence has not been discovered
tests.action: Inspect street arrows, the phone map, and direct travel requests
tests.expected: The residence name, route, and entrance remain hidden and unavailable.

tests.setup: A quest or NPC invitation reveals a residence
tests.action: Open the map and follow its route
tests.expected: The residence becomes visible and travel arrives at its authored entrance.

tests.setup: The player may visit an NPC's shared living area but has no private-room grant
tests.expected: Bedrooms, employee rooms, and restricted household rooms remain unavailable until their separate authored permission is granted.

tests.setup: New student with sufficient credit and upfront funds
tests.action: Enroll and apply for the Cypress Hall room
tests.expected: Enrollment, credit, income, and funds are checked; a durable lease is created exactly once.

tests.setup: Player owns or rents an acquired residence
tests.action: Move into it from the Hale home
tests.expected: One block passes and the household, active residence, VN room, storage access, discovery, and move history all update.

tests.setup: An active lease or mortgage reaches its monthly due date
tests.expected: The charge is paid once or becomes arrears; missed payment lowers credit and an on-time mortgage payment reduces principal.

tests.setup: Housing contract and move history exist
tests.expected: Contracts, current home, household, storage access, payment history, arrears, and mortgage balance survive exactly.

tests.setup: Enroll at Westshore active during office hours
tests.action: Choose program, load, and tuition plan
tests.expected: Enrollment state and non-conflicting class calendar events are created.

tests.action: Review a listing and submit a valid application
tests.expected: Requirements are shown and a single application record is created.

tests.setup: Player lacks a hard job requirement
tests.expected: The missing requirement is explained and application does not advance to interview.

tests.action: Arrive on time and complete the conversation
tests.expected: Quest, memory, meters, and chosen friendship or romantic branch update once.
No-show consequences apply and the original scene does not play as on-time.

tests.setup: Rachel is available at Forge Fitness
tests.expected: Strength plan unlocks and beginner workout is added to calendar.
The quest appears as an available offer but remains inactive until the player accepts it.

tests.setup: A discovered quest has an unmet visible stat or relationship gate
tests.expected: The offer remains inactive and clearly explains the known requirement without exposing hidden requirements.

tests.action: Postpone, reconsider, then accept or decline
tests.expected: Every decision moves the quest to the correct saved state without silently starting it.

tests.setup: Build a Training Rhythm is active at 0/5
tests.expected: The tracker changes to 1/5, records one completion, resets the run objective, and enforces the authored cooldown.

tests.setup: Build a Training Rhythm is at 4/5 and all requirements are met
tests.action: Complete a fifth valid Forge workout
tests.expected: The first stage becomes complete at 5/5 and Consistency Under Pressure unlocks at 0/10.

tests.setup: A counted run's cooldown has elapsed but another authored requirement is no longer met
tests.expected: The next run stays inactive until every normal requirement is met again.
Clock, needs, schedules, and due events update exactly once.

tests.setup: Atomic event with one invalid sub-effect
tests.expected: No sub-effects persist and a recoverable validation error is recorded.

tests.setup: Observe a named NPC across two scheduled blocks
tests.expected: NPC location and availability follow opening-week schedule data.

tests.setup: Keep open-ended quests active and advance beyond Sunday
tests.expected: No planning screen is forced, no weekly priorities are assigned, and open-ended quests remain available.

tests.setup: Changed money, needs, quest, relationship, inventory, and location
tests.expected: All changed values and current context match exactly with no duplicate effects.
Conversation resumes at the same node with effects applied neither zero nor twice.
Origin, destination, mode, cost state, and remaining travel time resume correctly.

tests.setup: Primary save checksum intentionally corrupted with valid backup
tests.expected: Backup is offered or recovered and corrupted file is not deleted.
Three autosave slots remain and the oldest is replaced.
Backup is created, migration advances to version 1 once, and migration log is stored.
Text remains readable without clipping required controls or choices.

tests.action: Complete menu, dialogue choice, phone navigation, and interaction without mouse
tests.expected: Visible focus and all required actions work with controller.
Large transitions and camera shake are replaced by reduced-motion alternatives.

tests.setup: Development target hardware and full current content
tests.expected: Content validation finishes under three seconds and required location transition under two seconds.
Game sustains target frame rate and remains below the slice memory target.
